title: No eligible product clears the propensity threshold -- system says so honestly instead of guessing

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Lucia -- how can I help today?
Hi, I'm just calling to check my balance, but while I have you -- any offers for me?
Let me check your balance first, and I'll also take a look at what might be relevant for your account.
Your balance looks fine. Let me also check the account side properly.
Okay. Honestly I'm not too fussed either way, just curious.
Appreciate you saying that -- I'd rather only suggest something if it's actually a good fit for you.
That's fair, I'd rather not get a generic pitch anyway.
Nothing stands out as a strong fit for your account right now -- I'd rather tell you that than push something that isn't.
I respect that, thanks for being straight with me.
Of course -- thanks for calling, have a good day!
